# Axial elasticity control geometry

`axial-bar.step` is generated by this repository's FreeCAD adaptor from a
20 × 4 × 4 mm Part::Box at the origin using FreeCAD 1.1.4 / OCCT 7.8.
It contains one solid with volume 320 mm³, bounds [0,20,0,4,0,4] mm and
centre [10,2,2] mm. This is project-generated test geometry, with no third-party
model or recovered authored history. Native qualification regenerates the same
primitive independently; the fixture lets canonical development-kit cases run.
